about: The introitus of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, remove not Thy help far from me; look toward my defense. Deliver me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns. O God, my God, look upon me; why hast Thou forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my sins. O Lord, remove not Thy help far from me; look toward my defense. Deliver me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns.
